description: Scoped to what ui/tauriAPI.ts actually calls. Every plugin command granted here is reachable from any script running in the webview, so unused permissions are removed rather than left enabled. Notably absent: shell:allow-execute and shell:allow-open (nothing in the frontend uses the shell plugin — plugin help links go through the plugin host's HTTPS-only validation, and running a shell goes through the PTY commands, which validate the shell against a closed set). dialog:allow-save is absent because every save dialog is opened from Rust, so the chosen path is never round-tripped through the webview. core:webview:allow-create-webview-window is also absent: detached terminal windows are built in Rust (terminal_window.rs), so the webview still cannot spawn one — 'term-*' only grants the windows Rust creates the same command surface as 'main'.
